name: Transit Swap, Ethereum leg: Yoink's bot front-ran the attacker's last tx
verdict_reason: Block 15655281: Yoink's tx (idx 24) replays the attacker's last pending exploit tx (idx 43) call for call: the same 21 Transit Swap router calls on the same 21 victims, with only the recipient swapped to Yoink's contract; Yoink's tip is 3.000000002 gwei vs the attacker's 3.0 gwei, which put it ahead of the whole 3.0-gwei tier; the attacker's tx then reverted. Yoink publicly said it front-ran the attacker (on-chain message 2022-10-23) and sent exactly 26.505 ETH to Transit on 2023-09-06. Scope: this is the LAST of the attacker's 9 exploit txs on Ethereum (8 successful, then this one, which reverted); the earlier 8 were not front-run by Yoink (Yoink txs in blocks 15655000-15655400 touch the router only in 15655281 and 15655307). In-block evidence only: no mempool archive for 2022.
era: post-Merge (3 weeks after), pre-mempool-dumpster, vanilla (non-MEV-Boost) block
protocol_loss_usd: Transit Swap ~21M across chains (Rekt/The Block). Ethereum leg: attacker swapped stolen tokens into 5,183.7 ETH (internal ETH in at blocks 15655184 and 15655265); 3,180 ETH later sent to Transit (tx 0x2e9d1f3e). Yoink's front-run took 5,974.5 UNI -> 29.3065 WETH.

bots.replay_evidence: call_diff.json: 21/21 router calls match the attacker's after substituting the recipient; the attacker's tx had max priority fee 3.0 gwei and effective gas price 9.065325221 gwei; Yoink's is 3.000000002 and 9.065325223 (+2 wei).
bots.notes: Yoink's tx was a normal public-mempool style tx (no coinbase payment, type-2). Its second tx (0xb7882cc1, idx 0, tip 0, 0.714 ETH to builder 0xdafea492) is a separate sweep whose attacker origin was not established ('unknown').

headline_text: Yoink replayed the Transit Swap attacker's last pending exploit tx (21/21 router calls, recipient swapped) one tier ahead at index 24 of block 15655281 and swapped 5,974.5 UNI to 29.3065 WETH; the attacker's tx reverted. Yoink returned 26.505 ETH 11 months later.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Yoink idx 24 (3.000000002 gwei) replays the attacker's last pending tx (idx 43, reverted) with 21/21 router calls identical bar the recipient. It did not front-run the attacker's 8 earlier successful txs.
harmonized.headline_note: Front-ran only the attacker's last (9th) tx; the 8 earlier successful txs were not front-run.
